args.body:
Summary of Ironbark Tooling newsletter, linked article, and companion piece:

- Newsletter: This week's topic from Ironbark Tooling is retail returns logistics, pointing to a feature article on the subject.
- Article (blog.ironbark.example/2026/returns): Apparel return rates reached 24%; consolidated return hubs cut handling costs by a fifth.
- Companion piece (insights.ironbark.example/returns/companion): Reselling returned items within 10 days preserved most of the margin.
args.title: Ironbark Tooling: Retail returns logistics — combined summary
